trust_center.repositoryDescription: CodeSignal Trust Center. Hosts security and compliance artifacts including the SOC 2 Type II report, penetration test summaries, the subprocessor list, the Data Processing Addendum, and the privacy policy.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: The Trust Center landing page is publicly viewable. Downloading reports and other controlled artifacts requires requesting access through the Trust Center. Access is granted automatically on a matching corporate email domain, or after execution of a non-disclosure agreement.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Certified and customizable coding assessments delivered in a browser-based IDE, including the General Coding Assessment, the Industry Coding Framework, and customer-authored assessments. Handles candidate PII (name, email address, IP address), submitted code, scores, and proprietary assessment content.
Real-time collaborative coding interviews with a shared IDE, video, audio, chat, whiteboard, session recordings, and scorecards. Handles candidate PII and audio/video session recordings.
AI-conducted automated screening interviews with scoring and human-in-the-loop review. Handles candidate PII, interview transcripts, and scores. Uses third-party foundation model subprocessors.
AI assistant and copilot embedded in the hiring product for assessment authoring, insights, and workflow support. Uses third-party foundation model subprocessors.
Role-play and simulation assessments for sales, customer success, marketing, human resources, product, and leadership roles. Handles candidate PII and submitted responses.
Five-Factor-Model behavioral assessment. Handles candidate PII and psychometric responses.
Numerical, verbal, and abstract reasoning assessment. Handles candidate PII and submitted responses.

AI and human proctoring covering government-issued ID verification, photo and video capture, browser lockdown, plagiarism and similarity detection, suspicion scoring, session recording, and Leak Sweep content monitoring. Handles government-issued identity documents and candidate video.

Experiential technical learning platform with guided learning paths, hands-on coding labs, and practice simulations. Handles learner PII (name, email address, IP address), course progress, and submitted work.
Personalized AI tutor available within the learning product. Handles learner PII, learning activity, and submitted work. Uses third-party foundation model subprocessors.
Prebuilt integrations with applicant tracking systems, human resource information systems, and scheduling platforms. Transfers candidate PII and assessment results to customer systems.
SAML single sign-on with SCIM and just-in-time user provisioning. Handles customer identity and account data. Supporting service within the system boundary.
REST API for assessment creation and distribution, result retrieval, and organization administration. Supporting service within the system boundary.
Organization administration, role-based access control, and reporting and analytics dashboards. Supporting administrative interface within the system boundary.

current.service_desc:
CodeSignal is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for technical and non-technical skills evaluation and development. It provides pre-hire assessments delivered in a browser-based IDE, live collaborative technical interviews, AI-conducted screening interviews, behavioral and cognitive assessments, assessment proctoring and integrity services, experiential technical learning, and the integration, administration, reporting, identity, and API services that support them.

The offering is hosted on Amazon Web Services in the United States. Tenant data is logically segregated.

Customer data handled includes candidate, learner, and user PII (name, email address, IP address), assessment and learning content, submitted work, results, and, for the proctoring and integrity services, government-issued identity documents and session video. The offering does not process protected health information or cardholder data.

Several services use third-party foundation model subprocessors.
